pinTitle: Russians Vote for a New State Duma
paragraphs: The required map is the 225 single-member constituencies for the 2026 State Duma election. Older Duma district plans cannot establish the current boundaries.

The inspected Yabloko 2026 map bundle contains 99 constituency records across 43 regional diagrams. Its rings use local image coordinates rather than geographic longitude/latitude. It therefore does not supply a complete georeferenced national layer.
Still needed: all 225 geographic district polygons, matched to the enacted 2026 plan. No unverified boundary layer has been attached.

A further inspected 2026 map at duma.vollper.com explicitly describes approximate boundaries derived from precinct coordinates and Natural Earth regions, with schematic boundaries in Bashkortostan and Leningrad Oblast. It covers 214 constituencies on internationally recognized Russian territory and is not a verified complete 225-district legal polygon layer.

references.title: Duma 2026 map: author’s stated geographic approximations

pinTitle: India's Next General Election Picks a Prime Minister
paragraphs: The map requires 543 Lok Sabha constituencies, incorporating the subsequent Assam and Jammu & Kashmir delimitations. The geography applicable to this future election must also be checked when its plan is settled.

Inspected national datasets retained legacy Assam geography or inconsistent constituency assignments. Bharat Survey explicitly describes its public map as 2019 boundaries and says Assam and Jammu & Kashmir await new open boundaries.
Still needed: verified current Assam and Jammu & Kashmir polygons and a checked national constituency crosswalk. A 2019 map has not been substituted for the current plan.

A further Kaun Civic Data Commons crosswalk provides memberships for all 14 Assam and five Jammu & Kashmir parliamentary seats. Internal checks found every Assam assembly number 1–126 and Jammu & Kashmir number 1–90 exactly once in these 19 rows. This is useful membership research, not new validated geographic rings: the publisher reuses the previously reviewed PC geometry and its own output marks Guwahati and Nagaon divergent. Representative-point agreement against partly older assembly geometry does not independently validate the current borders.

references.title: Bharat Survey: constituency mapping and boundary limitations
Kaun Civic Data Commons: constituency crosswalk, methodology and limitations

pinTitle: Nigeria Votes for a President and National Assembly
paragraphs: The House of Representatives map requires 360 federal constituencies, including constituencies that divide a local government area. States and local government areas alone are insufficient.

GRID3 Operational Wards v4.0 includes Lagos and Rivers, but its 376 Lagos and 316 Rivers operational divisions differ from the electoral registers of 245 and 319 wards. The source explicitly describes its boundaries as operational rather than authoritative and warns that government validation is incomplete. Its license is CC BY-SA 4.0.

Research-only unions of the 20 numbered Port Harcourt operational wards produced two valid, non-overlapping candidate polygons using the indexed INEC 2015 composition. These candidates still require current electoral-plan and geographic validation; a complete primary PDF download was not obtained in this pass. They have not been published as election boundaries.
Still needed: an electoral-to-operational ward crosswalk and verified splits for Lagos Island, Mushin, Oshodi/Isolo, Surulere and Port Harcourt, followed by validation of the full 360-seat layer.

The official INEC RAC directory was subsequently downloaded and checked for the five split LGAs. It lists 19 registration areas for Lagos Island, 14 for Mushin, 11 for Oshodi-Isolo, 12 for Surulere and 20 for Port Harcourt. The GRID3 operational layers contain 20, 19, 20, 23 and 20 features respectively. A checked roster of all 76 electoral registration-area names is retained in the research catalog; matching the Port Harcourt count alone does not verify geographic equivalence.

references.title: INEC 2015 Info Kit: indexed composition evidence; download unavailable during review
INEC official Lagos registration-area centres directory
INEC official Rivers registration-area centres directory

pinTitle: The Gambia Elects a National Assembly
paragraphs: The IEC ward roster establishes 53 named constituencies. It supplies membership information, rather than geographic polygon boundaries.

Two geographic sources were inspected: 115 valid NDMA/OCHA ward polygons, marked valid on 1 September 2022, and 120 valid World Bank-derived geoBoundaries ward polygons representing 2020. Neither has a verified crosswalk to the current IEC electoral wards. Similar ward counts do not establish equivalent boundaries.
Busumbala, Old Yundum and Sanneh Mentereng divide older coastal ward groupings. Whole-ward unions would therefore need additional verified cut lines.

Still needed: current IEC/GBOS ward polygons or georeferenced legal boundaries, particularly for those three coastal seats, reconciled with all 53 constituencies. No administrative map has been relabelled as a complete electoral layer.

references.title: IEC: official constituency and ward roster

pinTitle: Morocco’s PAM Leads the 2026 Election With 97 of 395 Seats
paragraphs: Published partial coverage: the pin map now contains 65 whole-province/prefecture local constituency outlines plus all 12 regional-list areas. The legal composition annex identifies the whole-unit constituencies, and each has a one-to-one match in PJD’s 2026 candidate roster. The remaining 27 local constituencies in ten split provinces/prefectures are not mapped. Both electoral tiers overlap by design and are named separately. The OSM-derived outlines are cartographic, not legally surveyed lines; minor source overlaps and disputed-territory source geography are retained without a sovereignty determination.
The required geography distinguishes 92 local constituencies from the 12 regional-list areas. A map of 75 provinces alone cannot represent all local seats.

The downloaded annex to decree 2-11-603 of 19 October 2011 supplies local constituency composition. Its continued applicability to the 2026 election still requires confirmation. The inspected open geometry contains 41 arrondissements.

Rabat El Mouhit includes Hassan administrative annexes 3 and 4; Rabat Chellah includes Hassan annexes 1, 2 and 22. Available arrondissement geometry contains a single whole Hassan polygon. Assigning that entire polygon to either seat would not reproduce the legal split.

Still needed: the 27 local constituencies in Fès, Taounate, Rabat, Salé, Kénitra, Khémisset, Azilal, Casablanca, Marrakech and Taroudant. Whole-province boundaries cannot substitute for their internal divisions. Rabat in particular requires the Hassan administrative-annex cut lines.

references.title: Gazette mirror: downloaded legal composition annex
Interior Ministry communiqué: regional constituencies at the level of the 12 regions, 11 September 2026
PJD 2026: current local and regional candidate roster
